description: Change details of one of the operator's boats; only the fields sent change, and a field listed in `locked_fields` is ignored because the partner sync owns it. The answer carries `is_published` and `missing`, what the boat still lacks to be listed. Read the current value with its read tool first; this call returns the value as it now stands.

check_in_periods.description: Check-in rules by date range, in the shape get_boat returns them.

deposit_with_waiver.description: EUR: the deposit when the guest takes the damage waiver.

features.description: The owner-entered equipment slugs, the whole list: it replaces the previous one.

length_ft.description: On a partner-synced boat this pins the length against the sync.

length_unpin.description: true restores the governed length of a pinned boat.
